verdicts.rationale: Mechanism verified end-to-end. The anchored FootnoteCard body onClick (FootnoteCard.tsx:127-133) composes ac.onActivate() (cardStore.select+expand, anchored-card-store.ts:100-104,74-78) followed by the panel's TOGGLING onSelect (FootnotePanel.tsx:160-162). selectedId IS the cardStore-derived selectedFootnoteId (selections.tsx:119,201 idFor('footnote')) and onSelect(null) routes through makeKindSetter('footnote') -> cardStore.clearSelection() (selections.tsx:60-72). On a re-click of an already-selected card: ac.onActivate's select is a no-op (refsEqual true), then the stale render-time closure resolves to onSelect(null) -> clearSelection, dropping the halo; onJump also re-fires (FootnoteCard.tsx:130-132). This violates the project's OWN ratified contract: the orphan card was explicitly fixed for exactly this (FootnoteCard.tsx:223-226) and pinned by orphan-expansion.test.tsx:119-128 ('a second body click must not drop the halo'); the anchored card was never given the same fix. REPRO NUANCE (finder's stated step 3 is partly inaccurate): when the card is EXPANDED its body is a RichTextField whose EditorContent stops click propagation (RichTextField.tsx:534), so clicking INTO the editable text does NOT reach the root onClick. The bug is nonetheless reachable on realistic paths where the root onClick fires while selected: clicking the compressed-summary body of a selected-but-collapsed card (e.g. after a header-collapse, which keeps selection per the axis split — anchored-card-store.ts:88-92; compressed div has cursor-pointer and no stopPropagation, panel-primitives.tsx:1026-1077), or clicking the body-container padding around the editor. MEDIUM (finder's severity) is right: function works but misbehaves in a realistic case; recoverable.
verdicts.correctedRootCause: Axis-purity violation from double-driving the selection axis: FootnoteCard.tsx:129 composes BOTH ac.onActivate() (store select) AND the host's render-time TOGGLING onSelect closure (FootnotePanel.tsx:160-162) over a cardStore-derived selectedId (selections.tsx:201). The toggle reads stale selectedId and clears via cardStore.clearSelection (selections.tsx:67-71). Deepest fix is the orphan-card template: drop the composed toggling onSelect and rely on ac.onActivate (cardStore.select) alone (mirrors FootnoteCard.tsx:226).
verdicts.class: Any docked panel card whose body onClick composes ac.onActivate() AND a host TOGGLING onSelect over a cardStore-derived selected-id slot has the identical re-click halo drop. Same FootnotePanel renderCard wires it for the orphan branch too (FootnotePanel.tsx:175-177) but the orphan card ignores the prop, so only the anchored card is exposed. Audit CitationCard / Reports / Notes / Todos / Archive docked-card body-click compositions for the same pattern.

verdicts.rationale: Verified. useCycle is built over the anchored `footnotes` array only (FootnotePanel.tsx:80-85), while the rendered `items` list places orphanedFootnotes BEFORE anchored (FootnotePanel.tsx:114-121) — so the keyboard cursor order diverges from on-screen order and orphans are unreachable by ArrowUp/ArrowDown. handleNavKeys guards on footnotes.length and calls cycleNext/cyclePrev (FootnotePanel.tsx:96-110), which index into `footnotes` (useCycle next/prev, panel-primitives.tsx:2615-2627). The sync effect does footnotes.findIndex(selectedId) (FootnotePanel.tsx:92); for an orphan selection this returns -1, the `i>=0` guard fails, cycleIdx is left unsynced/stale, and the next arrow press activates footnotes[0] or the stale neighbor (useCycle.next: idx==null?0:..., panel-primitives.tsx:2617). LOW is appropriate: keyboard nav is a secondary affordance and orphans remain reachable by click; the divergence only bites when orphans exist (a delete-the-callout edge state).
verdicts.correctedRootCause: useCycle(footnotes, ...) at FootnotePanel.tsx:85 is constructed over the anchored sub-array, not the merged `items` array (FootnotePanel.tsx:112-127) that the panel actually renders orphans-first. The keyboard index space and the visual list are sourced from different arrays.
verdicts.class: Any panel rendering a merged orphan/unanchored-bin + anchored list while building useCycle over only one sub-array has the same keyboard-vs-visual order mismatch. Check the Citations panel's unanchored-vs-anchored ordering against its cycle source.

verdicts.rationale: Verified. The dangling-ref pruner clears the selection only when !entityExists (useAnchorHighlightReconciler.ts:157-159), and entityExists returns true unconditionally for inline-atom kinds (footnote/citation) — isInlineAtomCardKind => true (useAnchorHighlightReconciler.ts:84-90). handleDeleteFootnote dispatches the suppress-orphan event and deletes the atom but never calls cardStore.clearSelection (EditorPane.tsx:2745-2759). So after deleting the SELECTED footnote, cardStore.selected (and the derived selectedFootnoteId, selections.tsx:201) stays pointed at the dead id. The collab-claim broadcast pushes that stale id (EditorLayout.tsx:3131) and its effect does not re-run on the delete (selectedFootnoteId is unchanged; the collection change doesn't re-trigger it), so the claim persists until the next selection/click-away clears it. NO visible ghost halo: linksForRef -> resolveLink returns null for the removed atom and the unmounted card has no [data-card-key], so collectAnchorEls/selectedCardKeys paint nothing (useAnchorHighlightReconciler.ts:188-227). LOW is correct: the consequence is a transient, self-healing stale-state window (cleared by any subsequent click/selection, EditorLayout click-away path) and is collab-only for any externally-observable effect; the 'immediate keyboard Delete targets a phantom' sub-claim is weak (the footnote panel's key handler only binds Arrow keys, FootnotePanel.tsx:96-107).
verdicts.correctedRootCause: Blanket inline-atom exemption in entityExists (useAnchorHighlightReconciler.ts:88) defeats the pruner for footnote/citation; combined with handleDeleteFootnote never clearing cardStore selection (EditorPane.tsx:2745-2759), the selection slot has no owner that prunes it on atom removal. Deepest fix: for inline-atom kinds let the pruner consult live editor presence (resolveLink/findInlineAtomPos == null => prune) instead of always-present.
verdicts.class: Citations share the identical exemption (isInlineAtomCardKind covers footnote AND citation, predicates) — deleting a selected citation atom leaves the same stale cardStore selection. This is known-fragile lead #2.

verdicts.rationale: Verified the dead-sender half: grep shows startFootnoteDrag is referenced ONLY at its definition (FootnoteCard.tsx:25) and the barrel re-export (Footnotes/index.ts:5) — no component threads it to onDragStart, so no MIME_FOOTNOTE dataTransfer is ever set from the panel. The receiving end is fully wired: Editor.tsx:712-784 has the complete MIME_FOOTNOTE handleDrop branch (orphan immediate performMove + anchored confirm dialog) and RichTextField.tsx:350,500 handles the card-body drop. So the panel->doc footnote re-anchor/move gesture is wired on the receiver with no live producer. Severity LOW is right, and arguably code-hygiene rather than a user-facing break: the footnote MOVE gesture IS reachable via the in-text InlineAtomGrab drop-mode (footnote.ts:38-40 documents this as the repositioning path), so the user is not blocked — only the panel-card drag affordance is dead. SECOND HALF (duplicate-slice linkId/linkCard omission) verified as LATENT/DORMANT, not a live defect: the walker remints only atom.idAttr (duplicate-slice.ts:188-207) and leaves linkId/linkCard untouched; renderHTML emits data-link-id = linkId||footnoteId (footnote.ts:78-90), so a non-empty linkId on a clone would collide — BUT every live footnote-creation path leaves linkId='' (footnote.ts:62; the cell note 'linkId always ' confirms), so linkId||footnoteId falls through to the freshly-reminted footnoteId and no collision occurs today. Correctly flagged as dormant.
verdicts.correctedRootCause: Two distinct sub-issues bundled. (1) Dead drag SENDER: startFootnoteDrag (FootnoteCard.tsx:25) has zero call sites; no onDragStart is threaded to the EditableCard, whose default drag chrome is suppressed (panel-primitives.tsx drag handles preventDefault). (2) Latent: duplicate-slice.ts:188-207 remints only the inline-atom id, not linkId/linkCard — dormant because no creation path sets linkId (footnote.ts:62, renderHTML linkId||footnoteId at :78-84).
verdicts.class: Dead drag export + live receiving drop handler is a recurring post-InlineAtomGrab pattern; audit startCitationDrag (MIME_CITATION) for the same unwired sender. The duplicate-slice id-only reminting omission (no linkId/linkCard) also applies to citationId — same latent divergence.
